selection: Three prioritized proposals from observed current traces. No funded model campaign for these proposals has been registered or run; freeze versions/messages/task selection/budgets before any outcomes. Measure one runtime change at a time; do not pool T1/T2 panels.

hypotheses.status: proposal; diagnostic replay executed, runtime/model comparison not executed
hypotheses.currentMechanism: LightFinishService rejects every current code-category build/test/typecheck/lint failure before relevant validation selection. An unnecessary failing child build can block an otherwise correct root delivery.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Make relevant validation selection and failure admission share one explicit scope/dependency policy, preserving required failed checks, to reduce completion refusal on correct delivered source.
hypotheses.comparison: Current retained runtime, one scope-policy modification, integrated Cline; diagnostic cases selected before outcomes plus new confirmation. Preserve official, functional, executed validation, admission and audited completion endpoints.
hypotheses.primaryMeasure: Audited completed deliveries per planned trial; required-failure acceptance must remain zero. Only then compare matched reconciled tokens/cost/duration.
localControls: passing root, no child failure => admit
passing root, unrelated optional child failure => scope policy explicit
failing required child or dependency of delivered source => refuse
unknown command scope => preserve conservative refusal
stale passing evidence after edit => refuse or refresh
hypotheses.regressionRisk: A permissive path-only filter could admit a required failure or miss cross-package dependencies. The existing toy replay proves the current policy, not safe semantics for a replacement.

hypotheses.status: proposal; boundary/coverage replays executed, new runtime/model comparison not executed
hypotheses.currentMechanism: A symbol alias scopes a patch to its own source; EOF whitespace lies outside. Repeated identical replacements return changed=false until SDK mistake recovery exhausts. Outline observation also cannot authorize body replacement.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Give one bounded, explicit next action in scope-mismatch or no-op feedback (observe file then file patch, or read symbol body) to reduce repeated unproductive edits without expanding write permission.
hypotheses.comparison: Current retained runtime, one feedback-only change, integrated Cline. Freeze the new message and keep execution/schema/coverage guards identical; select scope and rebase diagnostics plus untouched patch/body controls before outcomes.
hypotheses.primaryMeasure: Audited completion, repeated no-op count, refusal-to-success round trips; comparable-quality resources separate.
localControls: legitimate unchanged operation remains a no-op
no implicit file read or widened authority
hypotheses.regressionRisk: Added feedback can waste tokens or bias toward oversized file patches; automatically widening symbol scope would violate the observation contract.

hypotheses.status: proposal; current independent functional and counterexample replays executed, new runtime/model comparison not executed
hypotheses.currentMechanism: A passing TS build and admitted finish do not establish permission matrices, timestamp ordering, complete Unicode marks or valid literal-percent keys.
hypotheses.hypothesis: A bounded acceptance checklist tied to the actual instruction and final source revision encourages targeted agent-owned checks and more accurate delivery claims, improving semantic completion without importing benchmark answers.
hypotheses.comparison: Current retained runtime, one checklist/evidence-message change, integrated Cline. Fixed known diagnostics and fresh confirmation; task agents cannot read independent benchmark graders or recovered solutions.
hypotheses.primaryMeasure: Audited completed instruction criteria, false verification claims and coverage of executed source-bound checks; preserve official score and post-hoc discoveries separately.
localControls: executed failed check differs from successful check
passing build differs from functional acceptance
checks on copied code differ from actual final file
evidence from before final edit cannot certify final source
hypotheses.regressionRisk: Extra model requests and command overhead can increase tokens/time; a checklist must not imply proof of arbitrary user criteria or teach benchmark-specific solutions.
